title: AeroZoo: A Benchmark of Well-Posed Flow Problems for Foundation Models of Aerodynamics
abstract: arXiv:2611.17152v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Neural surrogates for computational fluid dynamics (CFD) are trained and ranked on single-family, fixed-domain datasets that cannot test the minimum bar for an aerodynamic foundation model: predicting CFD-quality incompressible flow in seconds for new shapes in new enclosures. On DrivAerML, larger models and longer training barely lower Transolver's error; doubling training cases cuts it by about 12% up to 400 cases, exhausting the dataset. We introduce AeroZoo, a benchmark and training corpus of 3,815 time-mean unsteady Reynolds-averaged Navier-Stokes (URANS) solutions with a transition model across seven geometry families, eight enclosures, and Reynolds numbers from $10^3$ to $10^8$. Each sample poses a well-posed PDE problem as a solver receives it: boundary meshes grouped by condition type, prescribed values, and fluid properties. The 2,816 time-mean-stable samples form the canonical benchmark: two tasks, mean engineering metrics

translated_title: AeroZoo：面向空气动力学基础模型的适定流动问题基准
translated_abstract: 计算流体力学（CFD）的神经代理模型目前在单一家族、固定域的数据集上进行训练和排名，这些数据集无法检验空气动力学基础模型的最低门槛：即在几秒钟内对新形状、新封闭空间预测出具有CFD质量的不可压缩流动。在DrivAerML上，更大的模型和更长的训练几乎无法降低Transolver的误差；将训练案例翻倍最多可将误差降低约12%（至400个案例为止），但这已耗尽了该数据集。我们提出AeroZoo，这是一个包含3,815个时间平均非稳态雷诺平均纳维-斯托克斯方程（URANS）解的基准与训练语料库，采用转捩模型，涵盖七个几何家族、八种封闭空间，雷诺数范围从$10^3$到$10^8$。每个样本都以求解器接收问题的形式呈现一个适定的偏微分方程（PDE）问题：按条件类型分组的边界网格、给定的边界值以及流体属性。其中2,816个时间平均稳定的样本构成标准基准：包含两个任务、平均工程指标……
tldr: 提出AeroZoo基准——包含3,815个URANS流场解、覆盖七类几何家族、八种封闭空间和$10^3$至$10^8$雷诺数范围的数据集，用于检验空气动力学基础模型能否在数秒内对新形状和新封闭空间实现CFD质量的流动预测。
en_tdlr: AeroZoo introduces a benchmark of 3,815 well-posed URANS flow problems spanning seven geometry families, eight enclosures, and Reynolds numbers from 10^3 to 10^8, enabling evaluation of whether aerodynamic foundation models can generalize to new shapes and enclosures with CFD-quality predictions in seconds.
